title: Towards Lighter and Robust Evaluation for Retrieval Augmented Generation
authors: Alex-Razvan Ispas; Charles-Elie Simon; Fabien Caspani; Vincent Guigue
why_relevant: Proposes a lightweight open-weight LLM-as-judge metric for RAG correctness and faithfulness, tangentially relevant to evaluation of hallucination in RAG.
